tools.name: search_items
tools.description:
DEPRECATED — use search_<itemType> instead.

Legacy monolithic search across all 14 Elements item types. Still fully
functional, but prefer the per-item-type tools (search_photos, search_music,
search_3d, …) whose typed filter fields are enum-constrained per item type.

itemType.description:
Type of items to search (required). Valid types:
photos, stock-video, music, sound-effects, graphics,
graphic-templates, fonts, presentation-templates,
video-templates, web-templates, 3d, add-ons,
wordpress, cms-templates

searchTerms.description: Keyword search query (required, min 1 character, max 60 characters)

languageCode.description:
Language for localized content (default en).
Supported: en, es, fr, de, pt-BR
